title: The Spring
author: Arun Sahu
text:
Spring betrayed me multiple times,
And never showed up.
So, I waited no longer.

In a cold, windy, and cloudy winter,
As I couched,
Someone knocked,
A stranger.
I looked out of the peephole,
An apparition shivered and quivered.

She asked for the woodfire,
Insisted on lighting the stove, and
Demanded a cup of hot tea.

Grumpily and grudgingly,
I let her in, ignited a few pieces of wood,
Made her sit near the fireplace, and
Lit the stove to make her a cup of tea.

As I put the kettle on the stove,
Unexpectedly, spring bloomed.
